title: Source: Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating Huang, after he released a statement saying he "made serious mistakes" and fell below "the standards" (CNN)
summary: CNN: Source: Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating Huang, after he released a statement saying he “made serious mistakes” and fell below “the standards” — Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang broke his silence Tuesday, issuing a statement saying he would be “honored” to return as CEO.
